name: Yamagata Masakage
source: One of the four leading generals of the Takeda house. He is unshakeable like a mountain, with fortitude and vigor. He is the essence of the entire Takeda army.
translation: One of the four leading generals of the Takeda house. He is unshakeable like a mountain, with fortitude and vigor. He is the essence of the entire Takeda army.
